issues.reason: The English says her sister, without saying older or younger; Chinese 姐姐 specifies an older sister. The source female-name role and ordinary scene are sound, but the unsupported kinship age needs a separately source-bound translation amendment, not an edit to the frozen evidence.

The English my cousin leaves sex, relative age and paternal-versus-maternal cousin branch unspecified. Chinese 表弟 adds all of male/younger/表 rather than 堂. Keep this immutable row review-held pending a bounded amendment; the Anqing place identity itself is sound.

English my grandmother does not identify paternal versus maternal lineage, but Chinese 我祖母 fixes the paternal side. The city's source identity and exhibition scene are sound; a separately bound kinship precision amendment is needed before this row can count.
